title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode6 Don't Be Embarrassed

meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Go my own way. Say what I feel...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I tried to make each phrase sound cool or rhyme well as much as I could until now...)

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I think you're putting too much stock into making your lyrics sound cool, novel or whatever, you know?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Honestly, when I'm writing, I could care less about any of those things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, really. I mean, sure, some of the stuff I write comes out a little vague, but they're written that way because that's what I felt was best.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I try to find the right words for the best way of expressing my thoughts. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It really just comes down to not having confidence in myself.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'm done running now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll be much more direct and write exactly how I feel...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is the message I thought Saki was trying to convey. This is what I felt when I heard her song.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I think I finally got it right.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At the same time, it's so embarrassing to think that I actually wrote this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It seems so self-absorbed or conceited...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, I know...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku might be able to help me with this too!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
Is Miku or anyone else here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
They're in the AV room...
They should be watching that action film that Saki left here the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I see.
I probably shouldn't interrupt then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But what are you doing here, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was doing some mental rehearsals...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Maybe I should come back later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't there something that you'd like to talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, there is. I actually want you to take a look at my lyrics...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is what I have...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So...
What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I like it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's clear that your friends mean so much to you based on this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And these feelings should be amplified quite a bit when sung alongside the actual song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At least, that's what I thought...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, but... Did I go too far? Were they too plain or simple in any way...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seemed fine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How interesting these lyrics sound isn't what's important. How you feel should take priority, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So there's no need to feel embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Is that what I was trying to tell myself...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was wandering in the dark for so long while not knowing what I really wanted to do with myself.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Somewhere along the way, I'd convinced myself that my words wouldn't be able to reach anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's so sweet...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it captures the kindness in Ichika's heart so well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think I really like this one!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Remember how the three of you wanted to tell Hinomori that you want to make music that can touch people's hearts with her?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
And you succeeded with flying colors.
You got through to her, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not only that, you girls managed to reach everyone that was there that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (It's not about my words not reaching anyone. It's about not closing myself off and giving my voice a chance to be heard...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Not just my voice. Our voice.
I want them to hear us as Leo/need...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I have to start by believing in what I say...
bgm_area00001
The next day

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Ichika. You're here already?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does this mean you finished writing your lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I did...!
I'd like it if you all gave them a look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I can't wait!
Lemme see♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, what do you think?
I felt much better about these compared to what I had before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Out of everything you've written so far, this is my absolute favorite...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
These lyrics are sooo good!
This is exactly what I was trying to convey through my song, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. These get straight to the point and you've made how you feel crystal clear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, these are really incredible.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm happy to see that you feel this way about us, but it's also a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, since you're done, why don't we do a quick play-through?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd love to hear what our song sounds like now that it has words to go along with it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, me too. Ichika, is your guitar all tuned?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Lemme go get my synth ready!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This was the way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't wait to sing it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Our song... In front of a crowd...!
